cohort: 25,643 nulliparous women with a term single fetus in vertex presentation who attained the second stage of labor
finding: Epidural analgesia in nulliparous women with term singleton pregnancies in vertex presentation who reached the second stage of labor is associated with a higher risk of instrumental delivery but a lower risk of cesarean delivery, independent of the second stage duration, and does not increase neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia in nulliparous women with term singleton vertex presentation who reached the second stage of labor was associated with an increased risk of instrumental delivery but a reduced risk of cesarean delivery.
